# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> This two bedroom property is located in Lawless Terrace, a mature much sought after town centre residential location. Ideally located within very close proximity of Balbriggan town with a host of shops, restaurants, cafes, schools and sports clubs available this would be an ideal starter home or as an investment.
